0807b76a: architecture-floor names have explicit candidate assertions; every listed leaf must pass.

3290f198: silk_control_audio_bandwidth keeps the current rate during active speech and steps WB through MB to NB after switchReady; both-channel tests assert that source contract and TOC at every step instead of the removed immediate-rebuild expectation.

473a0434: the separate legacy/scaled/stereo down2-HP wrappers are replaced by the source-shaped analysis input path. Actual selected-C analysis compares every output and all persistent state hashes including mem plus hp_ener_accum through successive mono/stereo frames at 48/24/16 kHz. This replaces the old Go-to-Go exact/8-ULP wrapper comparisons.

fc81fb76: the separate hybrid low-band wrapper moves into PacketEncoder/silk_setup_resamplers. Selected-C encoder resampler tests compare exact samples and total count for six consecutive 24/48-kHz frames to all three internal rates; setup-resamplers additionally checks retained history and next-frame continuation. These cover the old output-length/non-silence and loose sine-continuity assertions.
fc81fb76: the same RES2INT16 boundary assertion is expressed at PacketEncoder.Encode; both inputBuf and xBuf must hold quantized 3277 for 0.1 input.

fc81fb76: resetAnalysisHistory is the actual side-reset call at enc_api.go mid-only exit. TestResetAnalysisHistory asserts the source-correct reset values and preserved entropy/LP mode per silk/enc_API.c:453-463; reduced dependency is caller-owned EncControl and has an independent per-packet coding assertion. The old expectation to clear entropy history is intentionally corrected.

fc81fb76: reducedDependency moves from channel state to caller-owned EncControl. The parent encoder reset test explicitly keeps PredictionDisabled and propagates silkMode.ReducedDependency; the packet test verifies each packet consumes that control.

fc81fb76: the removed test only asserts stereoInterpLenMs==8. The retained test asserts the same constant through exact interpolation lengths 64/96/128 at 8/12/16 kHz; it is not claimed as a PCM oracle.

fc81fb76: the separate approximate float interpolation/state API is replaced by the shared integer silk_stereo_LR_to_MS path. The live-C gate compares every mid/side sample, prediction index, rate, flag and final state for zero and nonzero predictor/history/width states (10/20 ms and to-mono); retained-history and reset-to-fresh-packet checks cover state lifetime. The deleted loose float monotonicity/boundary assertions are not preserved as a second algorithm.

036c4d51: unified encode entry runs the disabled prefilter transition for hybrid. The current live entry invariant checks complete preemphasis/history/overlap/period/gain/tapset/pitch-change state with both zero and active incoming gain, plus warm allocations. This preserves branch/state coverage, without claiming a C numeric oracle.
